high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Melinda Gates (@melindafrenchgates). Text: The caption reads: "From then to now, I couldn't love you more, Phoebe 💗 Happy 22nd birthday!" The post was made 14 hours ago. It has received 21,559 likes.
